title: Jab sakina ko qaza
body:
jab sakina ko qaza qaid mein aayi hogi
haye abid ne lehad kaise banayi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
jaake tasveere nabi khoon mein nahayi hogi
maa ne atharvi mannat na padhayi hogi
jab sakina ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kya kya na dile shah pa guzri hogi
qabr mein nanhi si mayyat ko litayi hogi
jab sakina ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj har simt fiza nauha sunaati hogi
paye abid mein jo zanjeer pehnayi hogi
jab sakina ko…
